description: This file defines an internal interface IRemoteSiloProber for probing remote silos in the Orleans runtime membership service. It includes method signatures for direct and indirect probing of silos to check their responsiveness.
external_methods: Task<IndirectProbeResponse> ProbeIndirectly(SiloAddress, SiloAddress, TimeSpan, int, CancellationToken)

classes.name: IRemoteSiloProber
classes.description: An internal interface responsible for probing remote silos for responsiveness within the Orleans runtime membership service.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Probes the specified silo for responsiveness, returning a task that completes successfully if the silo responds.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Probes a target silo indirectly via an intermediary silo, with a specified timeout, returning an IndirectProbeResponse.

calls: Task<IndirectProbeResponse> ProbeIndirectly(SiloAddress, SiloAddress, TimeSpan, int, CancellationToken)
